summary: Bank of Nova Scotia filed Form 6-K with an exhibit press release commenting on the expected net income contribution (approximately CAD 77 million reported, CAD 85 million adjusted) from its existing ownership interest in KeyCorp for Q2 2026. This is a routine earnings-related update from a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16. There are no new special-situation events such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing is merely informational regarding quarterly financial performance without any structural corporate action. As a non-US filing, the 6-K is the US equivalent of a foreign issuer's periodic report, not a special situation.
